item.title: SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Trailer Could Swing Online Sooner Than Expected
item.description: We may finally have some good news about the long-awaited Spider-Man: Brand New Day trailer, as it could be heading our way a little sooner than expected.

item.title: Callum Turner Responds To JAMES BOND Rumors: "It's Very Early For That Question..."
item.description: Callum Turner has responded to the recent rumor that he's a "top choice" to play the next James Bond, and while he declined to comment, he didn't deny the report...

item.title: CHARLIE'S ANGELS Movie Reboot In The Works; Drew Barrymore Reportedly Producing
item.description: The Charlie's Angels franchise is reportedly coming back to theaters, as Sony Pictures has found a writer—and potentially an A-list producer—to reimagine the long-running action property.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Star Robert Downey Jr. Shares Doctor Doom And Iron Man Artwork For Valentine's Day
item.description: To celebrate Valentine's Day, the MCU's Doctor Doom, Robert Downey Jr., has shared some fun artwork of Victor—and Iron Man—in some surprisingly romantic settings.

item.title: SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Promo Art Leak May Fully Reveal The Scorpion's MCU Redesign
item.description: More possible promo art for Spider-Man: Brand New Day has found its way online, this time offering what could be our first look at Michael Mando suited up as the MCU's Scorpion.

item.title: SUPERGIRL And Krypto Share The Love In New Valentine's Day Teaser
item.description: DC Studios has shared a new Valentine's Day social media spot for Supergirl, and it features some new footage of the Woman of Tomorrow and Krypto...

item.title: SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Promo Art Reveals The Hulk's Latest Transformation, Spidey's New Suit
item.description: Yes, more alleged Spider-Man: Brand New Day promo art has arrived, this time showing off The Hulk's return to a previous form and Peter Parker's spectacular comic-accurate costume.

item.title: Happy Valentine's Day! Here Are 11 Romantic Superhero Movies You Can Watch With Your Significant Other
item.description: Love is in the air, and to celebrate the most romantic day of the year (if you happen to buy into that sort of thing), we've chosen 11 superhero movies you can watch with your significant other...

item.title: PIRATES OF THE CARIBBEAN Producer Says Recent Rumors Are "Close" To Reboot Plans
item.description: Jerry Bruckheimer has produced all of the Pirates of the Caribbean movies, and he's now responded to rumours about the planned reboot revolving around Jack Sparrow's son and Margot Robbie.

item.title: MASTERS OF THE UNIVERSE: Jared Leto's Skeletor Is Here To Haunt Your Nightmares In Chilling New Look
item.description: A new look at Masters of the Universe has been revealed thanks to some Toy Fair statues, and Jared Leto's Skeletor looks like he's stepped straight out of the classic cartoons.
